title: Green-Meldrim House
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Join an exclusive tour of Savannah's Gothic Revival Duo, St. John's Church and the Green-Meldrim House. The 75-minute tour of both sites on Madison Square will focus on the architecture of both buildings and how their uses and interiors have changed and been adapted through the years.
